Ya Muhammad Tere Daar Ki Naat Saleem Mastan.

1
Ya Muhammad Tere Dar Ki Kya Shan Hai.
Sari Dunya Tere Dar Pe Qurban Hai.
Sirf Hum Hi Nahi Tere Dar Ke Ghulam.
Har Nabi Teri Chokhat Ka Darban Hai.
Jis Ko Kehte Hain Janat Yeh Ahl-e-Jahan.
Haan Woh Janat Tere Ghar Ka Dalan Hai.

2
Nukta-e-Ba Se Wal Naas Tak Ya Nabi.
Tere Ghar Mein Pala Sara Quran Hai.
Kaisay Insaan Se Azmat Biyaan Ho Teri.
Rab-e-Konain Tera Sana Khuwan Hai.
Naat Teri Jahan Par Parhi Na Gayi.
Woh Shehar Woh Ghali Ab Bhi Veeran Hai.

3
Baap Ki Tum Ko Hone Nahi Di Kami.
Baap Ban Kar Tere Sath Imran Hai.
Naat Parhtay Hoye Maut Aaye Mujhe.
Mere Seene Mein Kab Se Yeh Arman Hai.
Lafz Qirtas Par Jo Likhe Hain Waseem.
Yeh Nabi Ke Nawasay Ka Ahsan Hai.

from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

path = 'src/data/lyrics/ya-muhammad-tere-daar-ki-naat-saleem-mastan-tajpoints-2bcd65fade6ddbde84e7.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path], text=True).split('\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
head, body = Path(path).read_text().split('\\n---\\n', 1)
roman = head.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def blocks(value):
    return [block.splitlines() for block in re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n', value.strip())]
original = [[line.strip().rstrip('.').casefold() for line in block] for block in blocks(old)]
transcription = [[line.strip().casefold() for line in block] for block in blocks(roman)]
assert original == transcription
source = blocks(body)
assert [len(block) for block in source] == [1, 7, 7, 7]
assert [block[0] for block in source[1:]] == list('۱۲۳')
print('Roman wording preserved. Urdu body has one opening line and three six-verse stanzas.')
PY"
